opening.comment: The agent did not greet the caller or give their own name or the company name in full; the opening was just a fragment naming the company, with no greeting or agent name.

verification.quote: Agent: Name and order number or postcode.
verification.comment: The agent asked for name and order number, which is correct, and the caller provided both before data was shared, so this step was met.

understanding.quote: Agent: Okay, Ahmed. 804257, a lamp €44.50, transit four 12 working days. So nothing it all has arrived?
understanding.comment: The agent captured the issue, but misread the order number (884257 became 804257) and restated the transit time as 12 working days, which the caller had said was 13.

resolution_accuracy.quote: Agent: You'll get an female when this investigation closes.
resolution_accuracy.comment: The agent did not state the correct timeline; the policy says the investigation closes within 5 working days and a replacement follows within 3 working days, and the agent gave no accurate timeline and misstated the order details.

process_compliance.quote: Agent: I'm puttin you on hold.
process_compliance.comment: The agent placed the caller on hold without asking permission first and did not thank the caller on return, both required steps.

communication.quote: Customer: My partial never arriv. It's been 13 working days an I'm absolutely furiou, this his the seconds time.
communication.comment: The caller said they were absolutely furious, but the agent never acknowledged the frustration and gave only curt replies.

closing.quote: Agent: Is there anything it else I can help
closing.comment: The agent asked if there was anything else, but the closing was muddled and the next step was unclear, with no polite sign-off from the agent.
